correctness.rationale: The exact source formula is F_v/V0 = E[(1-t^2 P)^(3/2)(1+t s)^(-3)] in dimension three, with s=<f,v> and P=|v^top|^2+s^2. Torus translations reduce a unit direction to block weights w_i, and simultaneous half-turn of all phase variables makes the functional even in t. Exact independent phase moments through degree eight give c4=(2 Sigma_2-1)/16, c6=(105 Sigma_2-41-690 Pi)/1728, and c8=(-382+1440 Sigma_2-555 Sigma_2^2-11400 Pi)/27648. These reproduce the published fourth-order coefficient. On Sigma_2=1/2 the sixth-order sign is controlled by Pi-1/60; when Pi=1/60 the verified eighth-order coefficient is 37/110592>0. The feasible product range and existence of the secondary boundary are proved exactly from the weight constraints.

value.rationale: The primary source explicitly isolates the vanishing-fourth-order locus as a place where its expansion cannot decide the behavior. The new result resolves that entire degeneracy in the first counterexample dimension n=3 and finds a genuine phase split rather than a uniform sign. It also resolves the secondary sixth-order degeneracy at eighth order, so every quartically degenerate direction receives a local sign classification. This directly sharpens the source's central Möbius-instability mechanism and identifies a new invariant, the block product Pi, governing higher-order behavior.
